before.text: The material has a row in Item Data by Warehouse (whwmd2510m000), Warehousing ➔ Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Item Data by Warehouse, for the warehouse its bill of material issues from. On that row's Supply tab, Supply System is Order Controlled/Batch, Supply from Warehouse is selected, and Supply Company and Supply Warehouse name where the stock is kept. A production order for the parent item has been created and released.

tokens.v: Order Controlled is a supply system that fills a warehouse from another one when an order needs the material. With Order Controlled/Batch, nothing moves until this session is run: it makes warehouse transfer orders from the supply warehouse for what the orders need. The transfer is an ordinary warehousing order, so it is shipped and received before the material can be issued.
